chunks: Abu Ali Al-Ash'ari, from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Jabbar, from Safwan, from Yaqub ibn Shu'ayb, who said:

Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said to me: 'Who is the harshest of the people against you?' I said, 'May I be sacrificed for you, all of them.' He said: 'Do you know why that is so, O Yaqub?' I said, 'I do not know, may I be sacrificed for you.' He said: 'Indeed, Iblis called them, so they answered him, and ordered them, so they obeyed him, and he called you, so you did not answer him, and he ordered you, so you did not obey him, so he instigated the people against you.'

key_terms.جُعِلْتُ فِدَاكَ: May I be your ransom/sacrifice (a common Shia response to an Imam)

ai.seo_question: Why are the people harsher towards the Shia according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: In this hadith from Al-Kafi, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) elucidates the sociological root of Shia persecution, attributing it to the spiritual allegiance of the general populace to Iblis. This divine irony highlights that the masses, having accepted Satan's call, naturally align with his enmity towards the Shia, who remain steadfast in their resistance to his influence.

en.hubeali: H 14553 – Abu Ali Al-Ashary, from Muhammad Bin Abdul Jabbaar, from Safwaan, from Yaqoub Bin Shuayb who said:

Abu Abdullahasws said to me: ‘Who is the harshest of the people against you?’ I said, ‘May I be sacrificed for youasws, all of them are’. Heasws said: ‘Do you know why that is so, O Yaqoub?’ I said, ‘I do not know, may I be sacrificed for youasws’. Heasws said: ‘It is Ibleesla who called them, so they answered himla, and ordered them, so they obeyed himla, and hela called you, so you did not answer himla, and hela ordered you, so you did not obey himla, so hela beckons (instigates) the people against you’.
en.sarwar: 105. Abu Ali Al-Ashary, from Muhammad Bin Abdul Jabbaar, from Safwaan, from Yaqoub Bin Shuayb who said:

Abu Abdullah (a.s.) said to me: ‘Who is the harshest of the people against you?’ I said, ‘May I be sacrificed for you (a.s.), all of them are’. He (a.s.) said: ‘Do you know why that is so, O Yaqoub?’ I said, ‘I do not know, may I be sacrificed for you (a.s.)’. He (a.s.) said: ‘It is Iblees (la) who called them, so they answered him (la), and ordered them, so they obeyed him (la), and he (la) called you, so you did not answer him (la), and he (la) ordered you, so you did not obey him (la), so he (la) beckons (instigates) the people against you’.
